minThreads.description: Minimal number of threads always running in this thread-pool

initialThreads.description: Number of threads started when the thread-pool is started

maxThreads.description: Maximum number of threads allowed in this thread-pool

threadKeepAliveTime.description:
Maximum time for idle threads to wait before termination.

Timeout applied for threads only if current number of running threads greater than {@link #minThreads}.
Default is 1 minute.

@see #minThreads

actionQueueCapacity.description:
Capacity of the queue to hold tasks in if the thread-pool does not have any available threads

Keep value empty to have queue of infinite capacity.
Running tasks are not part of the queue.

@see Err.actionQueueFull

defaultQueueTimeout.description: Max time action will spend in the queue before failing with {@link Err.Unavailable#threadInThreadPool}

py.description: Configurations for managing Python interpreters within this thread pool

onThreadStartRetrySpec.description:
Retry specification {@link RetrySpec} for thread initialization {@link Engine#onEngineThreadStart}.
Will use the default RetrySpec if not specified. Please note that the default RetrySpec will not retry
on any error thrown in thread initialization and you have to manually set {@link RetrySpec#retryAllErrors}
to enable retrying.

name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem
